meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行计划,由多个智能体分工推进并持续记录进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已经排好一份计划,想交给 AI 智能体按步骤执行并保持进度同步
copy.tagline_en: Run your plan with parallel agents and keep progress tracked.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a ready plan and want AI agents to execute it while keeping progress tracked.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会变成执行计划的调度者:先选好 .omo/plans 下的计划,再把实现、测试、QA 全部拆给并行子代理去做,自己只负责进度跟踪、验收和记录证据。
howto.when: 计划制定完成后,当你说“start work”“execute plan”等,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的某个计划时触发;若还没有计划,会自动调用 ulw-plan 先生成计划。

say.text: 开始工作,按 .omo/plans 里的计划执行。
say.note: 会选中计划并开始调度子代理执行。

say.text: 执行计划,并生成一个 PR 交付。
say.note: 会创建 worktree,完成后推送并开 PR。

say.text: 继续计划,处理剩余未完成的检查项。
say.note: 从上次中断处接着推进。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator that executes a Prometheus plan: it selects the plan under .omo/plans, delegates implementation, testing, and QA to parallel subagents, and handles progress tracking, verdicts, and evidence recording itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "start work", "execute plan", etc., or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no plan exists, it auto-generates one first.

say_en.text: Start work and execute the plan under .omo/plans.
say_en.note: It selects the plan and starts dispatching subagents.

say_en.text: Execute the plan and deliver a pull request.
say_en.note: It creates a worktree and opens a PR when done.

say_en.text: Continue the plan and finish remaining tasks.
say_en.note: It picks up from where it left off.
